For domestic and commercial use. High performance, fast-setting, wall and floor tile adhesive with no vertical slip. Fixes ceramic, porcelain, stone tiles and mosaics. Suitable for bathrooms, showers and wet areas, and can be used with underfloor heating and in swimming pools. Ideal for natural stone tiles to avoid staining or shadowing. Use before grouting with a light-coloured grout.
b: Suitable for Ceramic, Porcelain, Mosaic & Natural Stone Tiles
